messages:
rachael: Quick alignment 1 need a lean solution brief (1 page) + two launch posts + a webinar blurb for deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Focus: security controls, SLA tiers, and inbound lead routing for field.
ben: Ill take the one-pager. Need conservative SLA language and an ops-verified p95 latency line before final.
aj: Ill draft the product social post + webinar blurb. Proposed benchmark: mid-size chat (50k tokens/day) 1 observed ~22% unit-cost reduction with batching + KV caching. Ops please confirm.
sophie: Field wants one-line compare rows: Risk | SLA tier | Buyer profile | Recommended action. Keep each mode to a single sentence.
webinar-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Deploy Mode Decision Framework" scheduled 2026-08-12 11:00 PT. Registration: https://events.redwood/deploy-mode-decision
rachael: CTA decision: Field prefers "Request a Dedicated Eval" (primary). Keep "Start a Trial" as a secondary CTA for self-serve teams. Also add inbound routing note: high-intent -> Sales Ops; mid-intent -> SDR nurture; low-intent -> docs/trial.
ben: One-pager outline: 1) TL;DR 2) Mode at-a-glance (3 bullets each) 3) Security & compliance highlights 4) SLA snapshot (3-tier) 5) Benchmark pullout 6) Field playbook + CTAs 7) FAQ + webinar link.
aj: Conservative benchmark line for copy: "Typical 50k tok/day chat 1 up to ~25% unit-cost savings with batching & KV caching; results vary by model and prompt shape." Ops confirm preferred phrasing.
sophie: Dedicated Eval intake summary for one-pager (3 lines): Fill intake form -> security & compliance review -> sizing & 1-2 week eval -> post-trial decision. Total timeline: ~3-8 weeks depending on docs.
tom: I'll compress the intake and add expected reviewers (security, infra, legal) for the field sheet.
ben: Ops snippet for Dedicated autoscale (for ops quick sheet): ```autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  target_utilization: 0.65```
aj: Social post plan: Variant A (product-led): short metric + webinar CTA. Variant B (exec): compliance & SLA emphasis + link to request eval.
rachael: Please drop first drafts into the marketing drive by tomorrow 09:30 PT. Well review at 10:00. React with :eyes: when posted.
webinar-bot: Registered attendees: 14 (auto-update hourly).
